title: 第 14 章 在师姐的浴池内修炼
novel_title: 我被师姐凌辱，你说我罪恶滔天？
content_zh:
来到外门大长老住处的陆云，此刻整个人都显得格外激动。

    刚一进门他就开始当着师傅的面大吐苦水，而且说起话来也是越说越气。

    “师傅您一定要替弟子做主，那个陈默简直无法无天根本不把弟子放在眼里。”陆云说道。

    站在旁边的陆瑶也立刻跟着附和起来，不仅一脸委屈的表情还故意把自己脸上的伤痕露出来给大长老看。

    “大长老您看看我脸上的伤，都是那个陈默打的他还抢走了我的灵石和玉佩。”陆瑶说道。

    “那个陈默仗着自己有点本事就在外门横行霸道，完全不把师父您放在眼里而且他还说什么大长老算什么东西。”

    只听她在旁边不断的抹黑陈默而且添油加醋的说了一大堆，各种难听的话都从她嘴里说出来。

    那大长老听完之后脸色当场就沉了下来。

    没想到一个外门弟子居然敢这么放肆，甚至连他都不放在眼里。

    “你们说的都是真的，那个陈默真的敢如此狂妄？”大长老问道。

    “弟子怎么敢欺骗师父，您若是不信可以去外门随便找个人问问。”

    “那个陈默打了弟子之后还说什么外门没有人能拿他怎么样，还说就算是师父您亲自出手他也不会放在眼里。”陆云继续说道。

    只见大长老的脸色越来越难看他握着茶杯的手也在微微发抖，心中的怒火一下子就涌了上来。

    “好一个陈默，一个外门弟子居然敢如此嚣张本长老倒要看看他有什么本事。”大长老冷声道。

    “你们放心这件事本长老一定会狠狠的处置他，让他知道在外门还没有人可以无法无天。”

    听到这话以后陆云和陆瑶对视一眼而且脸上都露出了得意的笑容，他们在心里想着陈默你这次死定了。

    又说了几句之后两人便离开了大长老的住处。

    只是走出大门的那一刻陆瑶就忍不住笑了起来。

    “哥你看到了吗大长老刚才那个表情，我看陈默这次肯定完蛋了。”陆瑶说道。

    “那是自然有我师父亲自出手，陈默就算有三头六臂也没辙。”

    “那个废物居然敢打我抢我的东西，我早就说过他会后悔的给他的报应很快就来了。”

    两人走在回去的路上都是一副幸灾乐祸的表情，心里已经在想着陈默被大长老教训的画面了。

    回到住处的陈默还不知道外面发生了什么事，只见他刚坐下来准备休息一下。

    没想到眼前就出现了系统的面板。

    【检测到一处机缘福泽即将降临，地点位于青云宗内门的一处浴池之中。】

    【宿主潜入池下修炼可获得一道福泽之力，修炼之后能够获得实力的显著提升。】
content_en:
Lu Yun, who arrived at the residence of the Great Elder of the Outer Sect, seemed extremely excited at this moment.

    As soon as he entered the door, he started to vomit his bitterness in front of the master, and he became more and more angry as he spoke.

    "Master, you must make the decision for your disciple. That Chen Mo is so lawless that he doesn't even care about his disciple." Lu Yun said.

    Lu Yao, who was standing next to him, immediately joined in. Not only did he look aggrieved, but he also deliberately showed the scars on his face to the elder.

    "Great Elder, look at the injuries on my face. They were all beaten by Chen Mo. He also took away my spirit stone and jade pendant." Lu Yao said.

    "That Chen Mo is tyrannizing the outer sect because of his ability. He doesn't take you seriously at all, Master. Moreover, he says that the Great Elder is nothing."

    I just heard her constantly slandering Chen Mo and saying a lot of things with embarrassment. All kinds of unpleasant things came out of her mouth.

    After hearing this, the great elder's face darkened on the spot.

    He didn't expect that an outer disciple would dare to be so presumptuous, and not even look down upon him.

    "Everything you say is true, does Chen Mo really dare to be so arrogant?" the great elder asked.

    "How dare I deceive my master? If you don't believe me, you can go to the outer gate and ask anyone."

    "After that Chen Mo beat his disciple, he said that no one from the outer sect could do anything to him. He also said that even if master, you took action personally, he would not take it lightly." Lu Yun continued.

    I saw that the great elder's face was getting more and more ugly. His hand holding the teacup was trembling slightly, and the anger in his heart suddenly surged up.

    "What a Chen Mo, an outer disciple dares to be so arrogant. I want to see what he is capable of." The elder said coldly.

    "Don't worry, this elder will deal with him severely and let him know that no one in the outer sect can be lawless."

    After hearing this, Lu Yun and Lu Yao looked at each other with proud smiles on their faces, thinking in their hearts that Chen Mo, you are dead this time.

    After talking for a few more words, the two left the great elder's residence.

    Lu Yao couldn't help but laugh the moment she walked out of the door.

    "Brother, did you see the great elder's expression just now? I think Chen Mo is definitely doomed this time." Lu Yao said.

    "Of course my master took action on his own. Even if Chen Mo has three heads and six arms, he can't do anything."

    "That loser actually dared to hit me and steal my things. I already told him that he would regret it and his retribution would come soon."

    The two of them were gloating about their misfortune as they walked back, already thinking about the scene of Chen Mo being taught a lesson by the great elder.

    When Chen Mo returned to his residence, he didn't know what was happening outside. He just sat down and was about to take a rest.

    Unexpectedly, the system panel appeared in front of me.

    [It has been detected that a lucky blessing is about to come, located in a bathing pool at the inner gate of Qingyun Sect. 】

    [The host can obtain the power of blessing by sneaking into the pool to practice. After practicing, the host can obtain a significant improvement in strength. 】
title_en: Chapter 14 Practicing in Senior Sister’s Bath
